g.text: End-to-End System Architecture: 100% Simulation Parity & Zero-Dependency Web Deployment
Unified dataflow across JavaScript game physics, headless Node.js training bridge, PyTorch Deep RL, and in-browser inference runtime
Arcade Layout: 88 breakable bricks (8 rows × 16 cols)
Angle Mechanics: Dynamic paddle surface reflection
Discrete Controls: 3 Actions [0: Stay, 1: Left, 2: Right]
Line-Buffered Protocol: JSON lines via stdin/stdout
Zero Sim-Gap: Runs the identical JS game engine
Standard API: reset() and step(action) methods
Ball Loss Penalty: -12.0 on terminal drop
Batch Tensorization: PyTorch float32 on CUDA GPU
Storage Structure: (s_t, a_t, r_t, s_{t+1}, done) tuples
Decorrelation: Breaks temporal correlation in trajectory
GPU Pre-fetching: Pinned memory async device transfer
Dueling Fusion: Concat (128) → V(s) [1] & A(s, a) [3]
Double DQN Target: a* = argmax Q_online; Q_target(s', a*)
Target Net Decoupling: Hard copy every 1,000 steps
Loss & Optimizer: Smooth L1 Huber Loss + Adam (α = 1e-4)
Exploration Decay: Linear ε: 1.0 → 0.02 over 100k steps
Model Exporter: Serializes model weights to JSON (~4.8MB)
410k Parameters: Conv filters, biases, linear heads
Zero Runtime Bloat: No TensorFlow.js / No ONNX Web
Hand-Coded Conv2D: Spatial feature extraction in pure JS
Pre-allocated Buffers: Flat Float32Array (Zero GC pauses)
Ultra-Low Latency: < 0.8 ms inference per frame on CPU
Decision Rule: a = argmax [ Q(s, STAY), Q(s, LEFT), Q(s, RIGHT) ]
Action Repeat Lock: Holds chosen action for 4 frames
Perfect Fidelity: Matches training frame-skip exactly
Kinematic Decoupling: Separates physics from rendering
Stability: Eliminates jitter with paddle deadzone logic
HTML5 Canvas: Smooth 60 FPS requestAnimationFrame loop
Dual Mode: Instant toggling: Human Player ↔ Autonomous AI
Live Telemetry HUD: Real-time Q-values (Stay, Left, Right)
Performance Metrics: FPS monitor, latency (<0.8ms), score
Zero Server Cost: Fully client-side; static CDN hosting
Reactive UI: Real-time state synchronizer in React 19
Bidirectional Physics Parity Assurance Loop: The browser client executes the exact same underlying JavaScript engine (frontend/src/engine/rlEnvironment.js)
that was invoked under headless Node.js during reinforcement learning training. This architectural unification completely eliminates the classical sim-to-sim gap.
